negative_reviews.author: Shun
negative_reviews.text:
Cute staff but the food is absolutely disgusting
First time eating a bad vegan dish and by far the worst ramen I’ve ever tasted

negative_reviews.author: Paula. MzG
negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) I had the vegan tofu ramen and was unfortunately a little disappointed, as it tasted rather bland and also looked different than in the pictures on the menu.

(Original)
Ich hatte das vegane Tofu Ramen und war leider ein bisschen enttäuscht, da es recht langweilig geschmeckt hat und auch anders aussah als auf den Bildern auf der Karte.

negative_reviews.author: Julia-Marie
negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) All in all, it was okay since we got a table without a reservation, but we had to wait 30 minutes for our food. The broth was very tasty, as were the garnishes, although the meat was quite fatty and flabby. The service seemed unenthusiastic. The price-performance ratio wasn't really there. On top of that, I didn't think the 10% service charge was justified for the service provided.

(Original)
all in all wars schon gut, da wir ohne Reservierung einen Platz bekommen haben, aber wir mussten 30 Minuten auf unser Essen warten. Die Brühe war sehr lecker, die Einlagen auch, wobei das Fleisch schon sehr viel Fett/Wabbel hatte. Die Bedienung schien lustlos. Preis-Leistung nicht wirklich gegeben. Obendrauf die 10% Servicefee fand ich nicht gerechtfertigt für den Service.

negative_reviews.author: Lisa Collins
negative_reviews.text: Average food at a high price. It was okay, wouldn't come here again, have had better ramen elsewhere. Also added a sneaky service charge and don't tell you which I didn't appreciate.
